correctness.rationale: The base-six index decimation obeys coefficient-18 recurrence. The finite binomial expansion and Vandermonde valuation bound prove G_{t+2^r}-G_t = 2^r modulo 2^{r+1}, and J_{t+2^r}-J_t = 2^{r+1} modulo 2^{r+2}. This establishes surjectivity of F_{6t} on multiples of eight and L_{6t+3} on residues four mod eight at all m>=3. Direct residue exclusion and explicit witnesses show exact two- and three-term sumsets. Standalone finite script checks 10 moduli and 576 shifts; it is not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The cited 2026 additive prime plus Fibonacci-Lucas paper separates term parities. This theorem identifies an exact, persistent dyadic local exclusion for two mixed even terms and the sharp local-completeness threshold at three terms uniformly over every power of two, grounded in two nontrivial lift-permutation identities. It is a natural invariant in local admissibility of mixed sparse sums, not an arbitrary modulus census, and does not claim a downstream prime asymptotic.
